messages:
matt: quick ask — privacy team needs read access to redacted export blobs in analytics-prod for a one-off audit. duration ~4h.
Is it ok to bind group:privacy-audit@redwood.com to a minimal role on the bucket, or should we create an ephemeral SA and grant impersonation?

anika: prefer ephemeral SA + short TTL. cross-project project-level bindings feel risky. please include justification and exact object path. also log the request in the audit ticket.

jess: which objects exactly? if these are already redacted exports we can just grant storage.objectViewer on that specific bucket/path. avoid broad roles like viewer.

ryan: fyi cross-project bindings at org/project level can be messy for audits. recommended flow: create privacy-audit-sa@redwood-prod, grant iam.workloadIdentityUser or iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator to the group for impersonation + storage.objectViewer on the specific bucket.
Example command (one-off):
```bash
# grant bucket read for 4h via condition (example)
gcloud storage buckets add-iam-policy-binding gs://privacy-exports --member=serviceAccount:privacy-audit-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/storage.objectViewer
```

security-bot: policy: https://intra.redwood/security/iam-ephemeral-guidance — use JIT or ephemeral SA, TTL <= 8h, require ticket link and approver. checklist: (1) ticket id, (2) reason, (3) path, (4) TTL, (5) post-mortem.

matt: objects = gs://privacy-exports/redacted/2025-03-03-*. I'll open AUDIT-1234 and put justification: "regulatory review, no raw PII, exports previously redacted". TTL = 4h. I can do SA route if you confirm commands.

anika: approved with conditions — use ephemeral SA, TTL=4h, grant only storage.objectViewer on that bucket prefix, require 2FA for the group members during access, and paste AUDIT-1234 here when done. :white_check_mark:

jess: :thumbsup: I'll create the SA and policy binding, then post the exact gcloud snippets + expiry timestamp here.

ryan: when you post the snippet, include the policy binding audit log statement. I'll double-check before it goes live.

matt: thanks everyone — will wait for the SA snippet and then open the ticket link.
